call_purpose: Leads were arriving from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, then submitted a test form from another email address and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is advisable, and that you can do this in the email domain part of the settings.

customer_next_steps.timeline: tomorrow morning (as said on the call)
